reason: I'd use the free first visit on a Saturday, and if it's as calm as it sounds I'd pay the $15 weekend drop-in now and then since my 10-month-old is free. Pay per visit only, I wouldn't sign up for a membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, so unlimited never pays off, and $15 a visit plus coffee I may not drink adds up fast once the novelty wears off. I'd also want to see that it really isn't packed on Saturdays.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $10, or a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire for a few months.
